intro.h2: Thirty-plus years of kitchens east of Portland
paragraphs: Kitchen remodeling in Gresham, OR is the core of what Kitchen Concepts NW does, and it has done it since 1989. Walk into the showroom on NE Division and you will see cabinet styles and countertops on display, plus the same small team that will design your kitchen and then install it.

The team posts real projects with real price brackets. A small Beaverton kitchen that kept its footprint came in under $30,000. A larger Gresham kitchen, where an L-shaped island was redesigned to open up the room, came in under $50,000. Seeing those numbers before you call helps you plan.

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Full remodels and smart updates that keep the existing footprint. In Beaverton, the team kept the layout and floors but added custom maple Shaker cabinets, quartz counters, a full-height tile backsplash, better corner storage and a matching hutch for the dining area.

image.alt: Beaverton, OR kitchen remodel with custom stained maple Shaker cabinets, quartz countertops and a full-height tile backsplash

items.name: Custom Cabinets & Islands
items.blurb: All-plywood cabinet boxes with dovetailed drawers and full-extension soft-close guides, in maple, cherry, hickory, oak, walnut, beech, alder or paint. Brands on display include Canyon Creek and Omega, with Cambria, Caesarstone, Silestone and Corian counters.

image.alt: Southwest Portland kitchen with white painted maple Shaker cabinets to the ceiling and an espresso-stained island

items.name: Kitchen & Bath Remodels
items.blurb: Bathroom vanities and vanity closets designed alongside the kitchen so the whole house matches. In Vancouver, Washington, one family got a contemporary kitchen with flat-panel European frameless cabinets and two floating vanities in the same style.

image.alt: Vancouver, WA kitchen from a combined kitchen and bath remodel, with flat-panel wood cabinets, floating shelves and a stainless refrigerator

items.name: Entertainment Centers, Offices & More
items.blurb: Custom TV cabinets, home offices, entries, butler pantries, basement conversions and ADU remodels. One Portland entertainment center was built into an existing fireplace opening, with bi-fold cherry doors and the TV raised so every component fits below it.

image.alt: Custom cherry entertainment center built into a brick fireplace wall with a matching tall cabinet, Portland area

why_choose_us.h2: Why Gresham homeowners keep calling Dave

items.title: The owner is the contractor
items.text: Dave Warren is a licensed and bonded general contractor. The contractor responsible for your job is the owner of the company, not an outsider with no ties to the business.

items.title: Your designer is your installer
items.text: The people who install your kitchen are the same ones who designed it, and the installers work directly for Kitchen Concepts. The team has 59 combined years in kitchen design.

items.title: Prices you can see
items.text: Project write-ups carry price brackets, from under $10,000 for an entertainment center to under $70,000 for a large open-plan kitchen. A Vancouver kitchen came to $26,199 installed.

items.title: Built to last
items.text: Reviewer K. B. wrote that four years after the install there were still zero complaints. Plywood boxes and soft-close dovetailed drawers are standard in the project specs.

about.h2: A family business started by Dave Warren in 1989
about.text: David Warren founded Kitchen Concepts in 1989, and it is still a small, family-owned company. Dave is a licensed and bonded general contractor, so the person responsible for your project owns the business. Customers describe him as meticulous with measurements and patient with questions. At the Gresham showroom, Roxane, John and Matt walk visitors through the cabinets on display. At the Portland showroom on NE Airport Way, Mandy, Rod and Dave answer questions. Over the years the team has installed and remodeled hundreds of kitchens across the Portland metro area.

image.alt: The Kitchen Concepts NW team, with founder Dave Warren

process.h2: From showroom visit to finished kitchen

steps.title: Free consultation
steps.text: Call either showroom or stop in. Consultations are free, and you can see cabinet styles, wood species and countertop samples in person.

steps.title: Measure and design
steps.text: Dave or a designer measures carefully and draws a design plan around how you want the room to work, including tough layouts like a 1922 craftsman.

steps.title: Pick materials
steps.text: Choose door style, wood or paint, countertops and storage extras such as roll-out trays, pull-out utensil storage and corner lazy Susans.

steps.title: Install with the in-house crew
steps.text: Kitchen Concepts installers, who work directly for the company, install the cabinets. Long-time specialty subcontractors handle the trades a general contractor brings in.

steps.title: Follow up
steps.text: The team follows up after the install to make sure the finished kitchen is right, down to the last fine-tuning.

service_area.h2: Two showrooms serving the Portland metro area
service_area.text: Kitchen Concepts has installed and remodeled hundreds of kitchens across the Portland metro area. The Gresham showroom is on NE Division St, and a second showroom sits at 12518 NE Airport Way, Suite 125, in Portland, reachable at (503) 445-6350. Recent projects include kitchens in Gresham, Beaverton, Northeast and Southwest Portland, Oregon City, West Linn, Damascus and Sandy, plus Vancouver, Washington.

faq.h2: Kitchen remodeling questions from Gresham and Portland

items.q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost with Kitchen Concepts?
items.a: Each project write-up lists a price bracket. A Beaverton kitchen that kept its footprint and a Northeast Portland kitchen were each under $30,000. A larger Gresham kitchen was under $50,000, and a very large Northwest Portland kitchen with walls removed was under $70,000. A Vancouver kitchen came to $26,199 installed.

items.q: Do I have to change my layout to get a new kitchen?
items.a: No. Many projects keep the same footprint. In Beaverton the floors stayed, so the team focused on better cabinets, storage, durable counters and a full-height backsplash. When a layout needs to change, the team has removed walls, opened peninsulas and reshaped islands.

Kitchen Concepts installers, who work directly for the company and share the same quality standards as the rest of the team. Like any general contractor, the company uses skilled subcontractors for specialty trades, and most have worked with Kitchen Concepts for many years.

items.q: Can I see cabinets in person before I decide?
items.a: Yes. The Gresham showroom at 400 NE Division St is open Monday through Friday 10 to 6 and Saturday 10 to 4. The Portland showroom at 12518 NE Airport Way is open Monday through Saturday 9 to 5. Both are closed Sundays.

Yes. Kitchen Concepts offers free consultations. Call the Gresham showroom at (503) 669-6802 or the Portland showroom at (503) 445-6350, and the team will talk through your kitchen, your budget and what you would like to change. You can also simply stop in during showroom hours.

final_cta.h2: Start with a free kitchen consultation
final_cta.text: Call the Gresham showroom or stop by 400 NE Division St to see cabinets and countertops in person.
